It streams the run's events and answers `{ session_id, success, duration_ms, message_count, summary }` (`C/run/types.ts:4-29`, `C/run/runner.ts:145-177`). `port` and `attach_url` exclude each other. `on_complete` runs a command as the caller's OS user after completion; it is an effect of the operation, so who may pass it is a row of the security design
